record.original_question: Which smooth domains have non compact automorphism groups?

evidence.quote: Problem 9.1.1 Which smooth domains have non compact automorphism groups? 9.2 The Jacobian Conjecture

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Characterize the smoothly bounded domains $\Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ whose holomorphic automorphism group $\mathrm{Aut}(\Omega)$ (the group of biholomorphic self-maps of $\Omega$, endowed with the compact-open topology) is non-compact. 

Equivalently (by H. Cartan's theorem), characterize those smoothly bounded domains $\Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ for which there exist a point $z_0 \in \Omega$, a sequence of automorphisms $\{\varphi_j\} \subset \mathrm{Aut}(\Omega)$, and a boundary point $p \in \partial\Omega$ such that $\varphi_j(z_0) \to p$ as $j \to \infty$.

A widely studied conjectural answer (the Greene–Krantz conjecture) asserts: if $\Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ is a smoothly bounded domain and $p \in \partial\Omega$ is a boundary orbit accumulation point of $\mathrm{Aut}(\Omega)$, then $\partial\Omega$ is of finite type at $p$ in the sense of D'Angelo. Prove or disprove this conjecture, and obtain the corresponding classification of smoothly bounded domains with non-compact automorphism group.
artifact.category_tag: Automorphism groups of domains in several complex variables
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is the motivation for the Greene–Krantz conjecture, which remains open in general. Partial results are known: a full classification has been obtained for smoothly bounded Reinhardt domains (Fu–Isaev–Krantz), and the Greene–Krantz conjecture has been verified for convex domains in $\mathbb{C}^2$ and for domains whose boundary contains a smooth curve of infinite-type points. A complete characterization in arbitrary dimensions is not known.

status_evidence.title: Reinhardt domains with non-compact automorphism groups
status_evidence.snippet: Fu, Isaev, and Krantz give an explicit description of smoothly bounded Reinhardt domains with noncompact automorphism groups.
status_evidence.claim: The Reinhardt case has been completely classified.

status_evidence.title: The Greene-Krantz conjecture in dimension two
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses the Greene-Krantz conjecture in dimension two and partial progress.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is open in general but verified in special cases including convex domains in C^2.

status_evidence.title: The automorphism groups of domains and the Greene-Krantz conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of the Greene-Krantz conjecture and partial progress.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture remains an open problem with partial results.
